posts.cooked:
Greater Than Games, LLC is proud to announce its first expansion for the game Sentinels of the Multiverse! Please give a warm welcome to [i]Sentinels of the Multiverse: Rook City by checking out our Kickstarter here: http://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1787899968/sentinels-of-the-multiverse-rook-city-expansion

We will have an official video about it in a few days, so stay tuned for that, too! Additionally, throughout the course of the Kickstarter, we will be revealing more and more information about Rook City, so hold on to your hats!
